Theorem
[Derivative estimates---local] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0394 ↗ thm:chow-ii-shi-local-higher-derivative-estimates 1. appD:D.24\group Curvature Derivative Estimates

Let a Ricci flow be defined near the compactly contained initial ball $\overline B_{g(0)}(p,r)$ for $0\leq t\leq T_0\leq \alpha /K$, and suppose $|\operatorname {Rm}|\leq K$. Then \[ |\nabla ^m\operatorname {Rm}(y,t)|\leq \frac{C(\alpha ,K,r,n,m)}{t^{m/2}} \] for $y\in B_{g(0)}(p,r/2)$ and $0<t\leq T_0$.
